env GO111MODULE=off

# go help shows overview.
go help
stdout 'Go is a tool'
stdout 'bug.*start a bug report'

# go help bug shows usage for bug
go help bug
stdout 'usage: gecko bug'
stdout 'bug report'

# go bug help is an error (bug takes no arguments)
! go bug help
stderr 'bug takes no arguments'

# go help mod shows mod subcommands
go help mod
stdout 'gecko mod <command>'
stdout tidy

# go help mod tidy explains tidy
go help mod tidy
stdout 'usage: gecko mod tidy'

# go mod help tidy does too
go mod help tidy
stdout 'usage: gecko mod tidy'

# Earlier versions of Go printed the same as 'go -h' here.
# Also make sure we print the short help line.
! go vet -h
stderr 'usage: gecko vet .*'
stderr 'Run ''gecko help vet'' for details.'
stderr 'Run ''gecko tool vet help'' for a full list of flags and analyzers.'
stderr 'Run ''gecko tool vet -help'' for an overview.'

# Earlier versions of Go printed a large document here, instead of these two
# lines.
! go test -h
stderr 'usage: gecko test'
stderr 'Run ''gecko help test'' and ''gecko help testflag'' for details.'

# go help get shows usage for get
go help get
stdout 'usage: gecko get'
stdout 'specific module versions'
